description: This test file contains unit tests for FastAPI application endpoints and OpenAPI schema validation, utilizing pytest and FastAPI's test client. It dynamically imports the app module using importlib and tests various API operations including item creation, retrieval, and OpenAPI schema correctness.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: FastAPI's testing client used to simulate requests to the API endpoints.

methods.name: TestClient get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports the appropriate module based on pytest parameters and returns a TestClient instance linked to the FastAPI app.

methods.name: None test_create_item(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST /items/ endpoint to create an item and validates the response status and body.

methods.name: None test_read_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests GET /items/ endpoint to retrieve items and verifies the response content.

methods.name: None test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAPI JSON schema via GET /openapi.json and verifies its correctness.
